name: IOGarden
tagline: A map of plants from a global biodiversity database with an AI gardening guide for any spot.

awards: MLH: Best Use of MongoDB Atlas

problem: Gardening knowledge is gatekept and irrigation wastes water.
solution: Maps plant data from a global biodiversity database and gives AI-generated, location-aware gardening guidance.
demo_moment: Team-described: click a location and see plants that suit it with care tips.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH: Best Use of MongoDB Atlas” among 131 submissions.

lessons: Open scientific data plus a friendly map is an easy win for database prizes.
